newsitem.title: GERMANY: SKW Trostberg aims for 10 pct return on sales.
newsitem.headline: SKW Trostberg aims for 10 pct return on sales.

text.p: German specialty chemicals group SKW Trostberg AG, fresh from revealing plans to acquire a major company, plans to post a return on sales of 10 percent in 1998, its management board chairman said.

In an interview in the German business daily Boersen Zeitung's Thursday edition, Wilhelm Simson said this goal would translate into sales of around five billion marks and pre-tax profits of around 500 million marks.
SKW plans to have fully integrated Master Builders Technologies, which it is buying from Swiss group Sandoz AG, by that time.
Simson also said a capital rise could be possible at the end of next year or the beginning of 1998.
Simson was optimistic that the group's share price, which closed Frankfurt bourse trade at 41.90 marks on Thursday, had more room to rise. He envisioned prices somewhere near the "mid 40 mark level"
